summary: Native control plane orchestrating and managing AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin for streamlined software development workflows.
usecases: Centralized management and switching between multiple AI coding assistants within a single development environment.
Local-first execution of code generation and automation tasks ensuring data privacy and offline capability.
Automating repetitive coding tasks such as boilerplate generation, refactoring, and test creation across IDEs.
ideas: Integrating with version control to auto-commit AI-generated code changes with proper attribution and review workflows.
Building a plugin that syncs agent context across devices, preserving conversation state and project knowledge for continuous AI assistance.
Creating a dashboard monitoring agent performance, success rates, and token usage to optimize development productivity and costs.
